entry.name: midiselect
entry.digest: Select and interpret raw MIDI data
entry.description: midiselect receives raw MIDI bytes and separates the input stream. MIDI data to be selected for output is set using object attributes. There is a separate data outlet associated with each MIDI data selection attribute. Any input data which is unselected will be sent out the object's eighth outlet.
